reason: This PR is centered on a new table-level SQL feature (`AFFINITY`) with explicit parser grammar/AST changes (`pkg/parser/*`) and table metadata/DDL plumbing (`pkg/meta/model/table.go`, `pkg/ddl/*`, `pkg/infoschema/tables.go`). The executor touches look mostly like `SHOW`/InfoSchema exposure, so it is not mainly planner/runtime work, but it is clearly core to parser and table semantics rather than incidental.
